C-HOST-COMPAT-WINDOW.Summary: Replace the exact 2.0.18 host pin with a major-bounded supported window plus a data-driven verified-host list, so upstream OpenCode patches never require a vvoc release while unverified in-window hosts stay explicitly separated from evidenced ones.
C-HOST-COMPAT-WINDOW.Problem: package.json engines.opencode, the plugin-registration window predicate, the runtime service handshake, both live host gates, and the native pin manifest all hardcoded OpenCode 2.0.18 or the exact >=2.0.18 <2.0.19 window. Upstream ships several patches and a minor every few weeks (2.0.18 through 2.2.5 in six weeks), so every upstream release made install, init, sync, and launch fail closed and forced a vvoc release even when nothing in vvoc needed to change. Maintaining the same version in six places also drifted: the live probe still authorized only 2.0.18 and the native pin manifest duplicated the package.json versions.

Goals.Goal: Own the supported window and the verified-host evidence list in one runtime module backed by src/hosts.json, with verified/tolerated/unsupported classification.
Accept any stable 2.x host inside the major-bounded window at runtime and in the CLI, while refusing 1.x, 3.x, prereleases, and unparsable versions before any write.
Report a tolerated in-window host once with an explicit warning and in vvoc status/doctor, instead of failing closed.
Move build pins to the current verified host (2.2.5, effect 4.0.6, @opentui 0.8.2) and fix the host API break that removal of @opencode/plugin/promise/types causes.
Parameterize both live host gates by the host version under test so a version matrix is possible without editing gate code.
Add an upstream drift reporter that classifies the newest stable release and can fetch that exact host for the gates.
Document the update procedure, the bump train, and the measured 2.2.5 observations in docs/host-updates.md and README.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Do not automate publication: releases remain explicit release:bump runs.
Do not accept 3.x hosts implicitly; a future major still needs a migration change.
Do not change tool contracts, workflow semantics, config schema v3, or release automation behavior.
Do not weaken the type-invalid rejection path: a malformed value must still fail before execute.

Constraints.Constraint: Build pins stay exact; only host acceptance widens. The verified list is data, never duplicated constants.
Prerelease hosts remain outside the stable window and are refused.
Runtime discovery keeps using the native Service.discover contract; the predicate is passed through it rather than replacing it.
The live gates must authorize exactly the host version under test (VVOC_HOST_VERSION, defaulting to the newest verified host) and must keep verifying that binary's SHA-256.
Host-version refusals remain fail-closed before any config write; tolerated hosts warn but proceed.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/lib/host-compat.ts and src/hosts.json are the single source of the window and verified list, re-exported by plugin-registration so existing call sites are unchanged.
isSupportedOpenCodeVersion accepts 2.0.18–2.9.x and refuses 2.0.17, 1.x, 3.x, prereleases, and malformed input; openCodeHostSupport separates verified, tolerated, and unsupported.
Runtime discovery passes a predicate instead of an exact version, and RuntimeUnavailableError reports the window.
vvoc status and doctor print the support level and verified hosts; install/init/sync/launch warn once on a tolerated host.
Package pins are 2.2.5 / effect 4.0.6 / @opentui 0.8.2 and the package compiles and tests green on them.

contracts:host and e2e:v2 derive the host version from VVOC_HOST_VERSION or the verified list, and the live probe passes against 2.2.5 with schema-description and argument-normalization observations recorded.
bun run host:check reports the newest stable release, its classification, and the next step, and can download that exact host.
docs/host-updates.md, README, AGENTS, and the GRACE context, graph, and verification projections describe the window model and the bump train.
bun run check, bun run build, bun run pack:check, and bun run release:check pass with fresh output.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fresh deterministic output proves window and classification semantics, predicate-based discovery, CLI support reporting, drift reporting, and that the live probe passes on 2.2.5 with recorded host capability observations, without claiming the full nine-tool matrix is green on that host.
